question: Vietnam-level cuts of the GFI APAC Decoding Demand survey that are not public: frequency if concerns resolved, health benefits sought, drivers of choice, segment age and income, and the Vietnamese-language questionnaire
why_it_matters: It is the only large Vietnam sample on plant-based meat; the public charts omit Vietnam splits for several items and the exact Vietnamese wording (chay or thực vật) is unknown
cheapest_way_to_close: Download the full report through the GFI APAC form and request the Vietnam tables and questionnaire

question: Plant-milk sales by type (soy, nut and seed, oat) and by channel, 2020 to 2025
why_it_matters: Plant milk is the only proven modern plant-based category; product and price design depends on which sub-category is growing
cheapest_way_to_close: Buy the Euromonitor Plant-based dairy in Vietnam report or NielsenIQ retail data; ask Vinamilk and QNS investor relations
owner_org_to_ask: Euromonitor; NielsenIQ Vietnam; Vinamilk IR; QNS IR

question: Tested willingness to pay in Vietnam for protein-upgraded chay, blended meat and high-protein plant milk
why_it_matters: No choice experiment, auction or in-store price test exists for these products in Vietnam; stated ladders overstate
cheapest_way_to_close: Run a 400 to 800 person online choice experiment plus a 4-week in-store price test with one retailer (Co.opmart or WinMart)
owner_org_to_ask: AltProtein Vietnam with a university partner (NEU, VNUA, HUST) and a retailer

question: Which label terms Vietnamese shoppers trust: chay, thuần chay, thực vật, đạm thực vật, plant-based, giàu đạm
why_it_matters: Naming decides whether a product reads as religious food, fake meat, or healthy protein
cheapest_way_to_close: Randomised label test in an online panel (Q&Me or Rakuten Insight) with 4 to 6 pack variants

question: E-commerce sales of sữa hạt, sữa yến mạch, thịt chay and đồ chay on Shopee, Lazada, TikTok Shop
why_it_matters: E-commerce is where niche premium products can reach urban buyers; data exist but are paywalled
cheapest_way_to_close: Buy Metric.vn e-reports for these keywords (12 months)

question: Current plant-based items and plant-milk upcharges at KFC, Burger King, Pizza 4P's, Highlands, The Coffee House, Phuc Long, Katinat, Starbucks Vietnam
why_it_matters: Foodservice is where most first trials happen; menus show revealed chain demand
cheapest_way_to_close: One-day menu check in Ho Chi Minh City and Hanoi (in person or via delivery apps)

question: Size of the periodic vegetarian population (eating chay on the 1st and 15th lunar days or during the 7th lunar month)
why_it_matters: This is the largest existing plant-protein eating occasion in Vietnam and the natural launch window
cheapest_way_to_close: Add two questions to an omnibus survey; ask NIN whether its general nutrition survey records chay days
owner_org_to_ask: Q&Me omnibus; National Institute of Nutrition

question: Vietnam plant-based or flexitarian studies by Decision Lab, Ipsos, YouGov, Kantar Worldpanel, NielsenIQ, Mintel consumer, Cimigo
why_it_matters: Not checked in this wave because the web search quota ran out; the register may be incomplete
cheapest_way_to_close: Search these publishers in the next wave; ask each for any 2023 to 2026 Vietnam food-trend decks
owner_org_to_ask: Decision Lab; Ipsos Vietnam; YouGov; Kantar Worldpanel Vietnam; NielsenIQ Vietnam; Mintel; Cimigo

question: Results of the GFI APAC and A*STAR Asia-focused blended meat sensory study
why_it_matters: Would give the first tested acceptance data for blends in Asia, the most promising entry format
cheapest_way_to_close: Email GFI APAC; check A*STAR and Palate Insights publications

question: Whether Beyond Meat, OmniFoods, Next Meats, Heura, CP Meat Zero, Zhenmeat, Starfield or Meatless Farm are still sold in Vietnam, and at what volume
why_it_matters: Separates temporary absence from market exit; tells investors whether the import route failed
cheapest_way_to_close: Ask importers and retailers (Annam Gourmet, Nam An, Classic Fine Foods, Bewina); check Shopee and Lazada listings
owner_org_to_ask: Annam Gourmet; Nam An Market; Classic Fine Foods Vietnam

question: Food-safety premium in Vietnam: tested WTP for certified safe pork or chicken
why_it_matters: Food safety is the Vietnam-specific driver; the safe-meat premium is the benchmark a safety-positioned plant protein must meet
cheapest_way_to_close: Literature review of choice experiments on VietGAP and safe meat (VNUA, IPSARD); read Ha et al. 2019

question: Evidence on parents and children as buyers of plant protein (school meals, children's milk)
why_it_matters: Plant milk and soy milk are heavily bought for children; no study covers this
cheapest_way_to_close: Ask Vinamilk, Vinasoy and school-meal caterers; add a parent module to an omnibus
owner_org_to_ask: Vinamilk; Vinasoy; Ho Chi Minh City Department of Education

question: Expatriate and tourist demand for plant-based meals
why_it_matters: 21.2 million international arrivals (2025) and expatriate districts sustain the gourmet channel where imports sit
cheapest_way_to_close: Count vegan and vegetarian listings on travel platforms; ask hotel groups; MOLISA work-permit data for expatriate numbers
owner_org_to_ask: MOLISA; hotel groups; Vietnam National Authority of Tourism

question: Vietnamese-language academic papers not retrieved (e.g. Phan and Ho 2024 on plant-based meat intention in Ho Chi Minh City)
why_it_matters: They may add samples outside students
cheapest_way_to_close: Retrieve from Tạp chí Công Thương and university repositories
